headline: 5 Dividend Stocks Yielding Up to 8% That Could Keep Paying for Years
summary: A 52-year raise streak sounds safe until you put it next to a 7.8% yield, a reset dividend, and a consumer staples giant whose payouts free cash flow still covers even as profits shrink. Five income stocks, five very different kinds of durability.

headline: 3 Blue Chip Dividend Stocks That Still Look Like Bond Proxies
